part: 1 of 2: C, D, I and J (R52, R53, R55, R58); part 2 is SYNTHETIC_ALLOCATION_CASES.json
replaces: the 046e naming examples (cps.naming-examples.draft.v1), superseded for C and D by R52

resources.note: INVENTED placeholders shared by every case and by EXAMPLE_INVENTORY.json. They are not the owner-reviewed company resources, which are private.
resources.context:company_name: 示例機電股份有限公司

job_inputs.context:project_name: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

assumptions: Unless a case says otherwise, the line lies inside the quoted range (R49) of the detailed bill sheet, and every row carries L, M and N from the job inputs (R48) with K, O, P, G and H null.
Input cells are the line's own cells: description (a list when the item has continuation rows), unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, remarks. A missing key means an empty cell.
Expected values list only the fields the case is about; "row": false means the line gives no 未填 row and its cells take the stated census role.

input.description: 產品，控制開關，選擇開關，30mm

cases.reason: Equipment line (switch). The glossary prefix 產品 is dropped with its delimiter, 控制開關 is the category chain, and the head noun 選擇開關 has a glossary entry, so C is its abbreviation. D is the rest, verbatim. C derived through the glossary cites the description cell and context:glossary (R58).

input.description: 產品，計時器，限時繼電器，AC220V

cases.reason: Equipment line (timer relay). The glossary has no entry for 限時繼電器, so C is the head noun: the first segment after the prefix and the category chain 計時器.

Equipment line (meter). The head-noun segment 電壓表96角型 carries a digit, so C is cut before the first digit. D is the rest after removing the prefix, the category chain and C's leading noun part, verbatim.

Equipment line (switch) with no category chain and no glossary entry. The head-noun segment carries a bracket, so C is cut before it; the bracket and the rest go to D verbatim (a push-button switch is not a breaker-type line, so R53 does not apply).

description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC110V，

cases.reason: The continuation row is joined to the description with no separator. Category chain 電磁開關; head noun 電磁接觸器 has the glossary abbreviation XMC.

input.description: 產品，電線電纜，600V XLPE電纜，3C，2mm²

cases.reason: Material line (cable and wire): C is null and D is the description without the generic prefix, category chain kept, verbatim. Material lines leave I and J null even when priced (R55).
PLC modules and software are material lines under R52: C null, D the description without the prefix.
A valve written size-first, and any description that starts with a digit, is a material line: C null, D verbatim.
Service, labour and fee line: C null; D is the description without the generic prefix.
Single-segment description naming equipment (an instrument) with no glossary entry: the noun goes to C and D is null.
Single-segment description that is not equipment (hardware): it goes to D and C is null.
Remarks and code columns never enter C or D, even when they read like a specification; they stay in raw text. 指示燈 is the head noun (no category chain) and has the glossary abbreviation XPL.
Breaker-type line: D joins the rating tokens with single spaces and drops the wrapping brackets.

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，(AC，220V)，附輔助接點

cases.reason: A contactor is not a breaker-type line, so its D keeps its punctuation and brackets verbatim.

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: Priced equipment line whose own cells state no brand or model: the brand table entry for the device type and rating band applies. The fields cite the description cell and context:brand_table (R58).

input.remarks: 廠牌：示例儀器 型號：FM-100

cases.reason: A brand or model stated in the line's own cells is copied and takes precedence over the brand table. The remark supplies I and J but never enters D.

expected.null_reason_I_J: the brand table covers 無熔絲開關 only up to 100AT; the line states no brand or model

cases.reason: A rating the table does not cover leaves I and J null with a reason. The glossary abbreviation still applies to C.
